about.title: About
paragraphs: I work as a Senior General QA Engineer: functional testing, UI, API, automation, and test documentation.
My current stack is TypeScript and Playwright for UI, API, and E2E tests. I started automation with Java, Selenium, and Maven.
I have FinTech experience on a B2B payment platform, in the Access & Identity team: access, accounts, roles, and corporate client operations.
I care about a framework the team can trust in CI, fewer flaky tests, and shorter manual regression.

now.title: Now
now.body: I am preparing for interviews: Playwright, API, SQL, and how I explain the framework and Jenkins. Short notes and spoken answers live on separate pages.

points: Designed and maintained a scalable test automation framework with TypeScript and Playwright.
Developed 300+ automated tests covering UI, API, and E2E scenarios. Reached 90% automation coverage across core services.
Reduced manual regression testing time by 70% through automation.
Integrated automated tests into CI/CD with Jenkins. Used Allure for reports.
Created and maintained test scenarios, test cases, and regression suites. Tested APIs with Postman and checked data with SQL.
Worked with backend, frontend, and QA. Tested account management: roles, permissions, and access control.

items.text: Signup / quiz funnel. I test the business result (user created, trial funnel finished), not a fixed click path. A heuristic walker handles A/B UI; asserts go through API + UI. Smoke on PR, outcome tests separately.
